headline: Creative Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with experience building brand identities, digital marketing assets, and social media campaigns.

skills.label: Design & Branding
skills.items: Graphic Design, Branding and Visual Identity, Logo Design, Web Visuals, Typography, Color Systems, Layout, Visual Hierarchy

skills.label: Software & Tools
skills.items: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT

skills.label: Process & Production
skills.items: Print Production, Print-Ready File Management, Social Media Creatives, Marketing Collateral, Design Systems

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Worked closely with HR and management stakeholders to align visuals with project requirements while maintaining low revision cycles.
Utilized AI-assisted workflows including ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Developed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses and startups.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator to produce product visuals and marketing assets.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Designed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.
Maintained brand guidelines and visual consistency across all digital touchpoints.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Delivered a comprehensive logo, typography system, and color palette for an early-stage venture.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her commercial graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions and branding work at AT Creation, highlighting social campaigns and marketing collateral to match the creative agency requirements.
